description: This Java source file defines a FreeMarker template transform class 'CsrfTokenAjaxTransform' that generates CSRF tokens within Ajax calls by integrating with the OFBiz security utilities.

classes.name: CsrfTokenAjaxTransform
classes.description: Implements a FreeMarker transform to output CSRF tokens during Ajax requests within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: getWriter
methods.description: Returns a Writer object that, upon closing, retrieves the current environment, extracts the request object, generates a CSRF token using CsrfUtil, and writes it to the output.
